(a) Extinguishing agents must be methyl bromide, carbon dioxide, or any agent with equal extinguishing action.
(b) If methyl bromide, carbon dioxide, or any other toxic extinguishing agent is used, it must be shown by test that entry of harmful concentrations of fluid or fluid vapors into any personnel compartment (due to leakage during normal operation of the rotorcraft, or discharge on the ground or in flight) is prevented, even though a defect may exist in the extinguishing system.
(c) Each methyl bromide container must be charged with a dry agent and sealed. This must be done by--
  (1) The fire extinguisher manufacturer; or
  (2) Any person using appropriate recharging equipment.
